title: Cap-and-Track: Optimizing LLM Inference Request Dispatch Across Shifting Capacity
abstract: arXiv:2611.24891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A fixed dispatch rate for LLM inference becomes stale as serving fleets resize and request sizes change. Generative output length is unknown at admission, and shared provider pools can lose capacity. We present Cap-and-Track, a design for asynchronous inference across provider capacity and internal GPUs. Meta's traffic shaper implements Cap-and-Track for post and live-video understanding. Refusals signal the backend's current admission ceiling. Durable priority queues hold excess work outside execution, including refused requests for retry. Cap is a fail-fast admission check at the saturated resource that refuses work before a long wait. Using only those refusals, the Track dispatcher probes upward and backs off. It follows the ceiling without output-length prediction or a fleet-level rate to retune. In a concurrent same-traffic production A/B, the shaper ran per-replica Cap plus Track. translated_title: Cap-and-Track：在动态变化的容量下优化LLM推理请求分发
translated_abstract: 对于LLM推理而言，固定的分发速率会随着服务集群规模调整和请求规模的变化而过时。生成式输出的长度在请求准入时是未知的，且共享的提供商资源池可能会失去容量。我们提出Cap-and-Track，一种跨提供商容量和内部GPU的异步推理设计。Meta的流量整形器为帖子和直播视频理解实现了Cap-and-Track。拒绝信号表示后端当前的准入上限。持久化优先队列在执行之外保存多余的工作，包括被拒绝以待重试的请求。Cap是在饱和资源处的一种快速失败准入检查，能在长时间等待之前拒绝工作。Track分发器仅利用这些拒绝信号进行向上探测和退避。它无需输出长度预测，也无需集群级的速率重新调整，即可跟随容量上限。在并发的同流量生产A/B测试中，该整形器运行每副本的Cap加Track，以比基准少43%的H100 GPU服务了一个分类器（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: Cap-and-Track利用饱和资源处的快速失败拒绝信号驱动分发器自动向上探测和退避，无需预测输出长度或手动调整集群级速率即可跟随动态变化的容量上限，并在生产A/B测试中以少43%的H100 GPU服务了相同流量。
